ICS 21.100.20
ICS 21.100.20
PGD 13
PGD 13
(Superseeding IS 14691 : 1999)
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the requirements and test methods for tapered roller used in rolling bearings.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
